records.title: World Bank approves US$215.9 million Burkina Faso Agricultural Transformation Project
records.summary: The project supports agricultural productivity, value chains, processing, market access and private investment in Burkina Faso.

records.title: World Bank approves US$40 million SAVIG programme in Sierra Leone
records.summary: SAVIG supports sustainable agricultural value-chain intensification, productivity, private investment and job creation.

records.title: FAO highlights Nigeria's ₦6.5 trillion NASIP agrifood investment plan
records.summary: FAO reports that MAFAP analysis helped guide more than one-third of Nigeria's 2026–2027 agrifood investment plan through evidence-based public-spending and policy optimization.

records.title: CGIAR THRIVE highlights soil restoration and farm diversification in Ethiopia
records.summary: THRIVE connects soil restoration, crop diversification, resilient planting material and inclusive markets as pathways toward resilient agrifood systems.

records.title: CGIAR THRIVE highlights soil restoration and farm diversification in Kenya
records.summary: THRIVE connects soil restoration, crop diversification, resilient planting material and inclusive markets as pathways toward resilient agrifood systems.

records.summary: THRIVE connects soil restoration, crop diversification, resilient planting material and inclusive markets as pathways toward resilient agrifood systems.

records.title: IITA study examines climate-smart agriculture practices across Mali
records.summary: A study covering 3,709 households and 8,391 plots across six regions examines climate-smart agriculture practices and evidence relevant to climate-resilient farming.

records.title: IITA calls for scaling agricultural research into transformation across Africa
records.summary: IITA highlighted the need to connect agricultural research with finance, policy and delivery, citing scaling examples including heat-tolerant wheat and aflatoxin management.

records.title: World Bank approves US$500 million Ghana Market Access and Connectivity Project
records.summary: The project will improve rural road connectivity, strengthen agricultural value chains and help farmers reach larger markets more efficiently.

records.title: Angola launches AgriConnect Compact for food security, jobs and agricultural growth
records.summary: Angola's AgriConnect Compact brings government, private sector, financial institutions and farmer organizations together around agricultural value-chain investment and reform.

records.title: Zimbabwe takes US$1.65 billion agrifood investment portfolio to FAO forum
records.summary: Zimbabwe will present investment cases covering maize, soyabean, blueberries, dairy and the Dam as an Economic driver at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum.

records.title: World Bank approves US$116 million second phase of Guinea Commercial Agriculture Development Project
records.summary: The project aims to commercialize agriculture, attract private investment, expand employment and strengthen key agricultural value chains.

records.title: World Bank approves US$500 million Nigeria AGROW project
records.summary: AGROW targets smallholder productivity and value chains including rice, maize, cassava and soybeans, with matching grants, market access, research, extension and digital advisory services.

records.title: Senegal expands agricultural insurance coverage against drought and rainfall shocks
records.summary: World Bank results report more than 835,000 farmers and breeders gained index-based agricultural insurance coverage against drought and rainfall shocks in 2025.

records.title: The Gambia expands improved seed and fertilizer distribution through digital systems
records.summary: More than 57,000 farmers received improved rice and maize seed through a digitally managed distribution platform, alongside fertilizer and climate-smart farming support.

records.title: Guinea strengthens warehouse receipts and agricultural risk management
records.summary: World Bank results report 100 approved warehouses under a strengthened warehouse receipt system and an index-based insurance scheme protecting farmers and breeders from drought and poor rainfall.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Ethiopia
records.summary: A new regional initiative is scaling climate-smart technologies and climate information services, with Ethiopia among the participating countries.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Ghana
records.summary: The initiative is designed to connect agricultural research with farmers by expanding climate-smart technologies and climate information services in Ghana.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Kenya
records.summary: Kenya is among the countries covered by the regional initiative scaling climate-smart agricultural innovations and climate information services.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Mali
records.summary: The initiative includes Mali in efforts to bridge agricultural research and farmer adoption through climate-smart technologies and climate information services.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Senegal
records.summary: Senegal is included in a regional effort to scale climate-smart agricultural innovations and climate information services and connect research with farmers.

records.title: AICCRA–FSRP4 expands climate-smart agriculture innovation in Zambia
records.summary: Zambia is included in the regional initiative scaling climate-smart agricultural technologies and climate information services for farmers and food-system actors.

records.title: Senegal AgriConnect Compact
records.summary: Senegal's national AgriConnect Compact targets grains, horticulture and livestock while mobilizing public and private investment in agricultural infrastructure, services and value chains.

records.title: Côte d'Ivoire e-Agriculture digital marketplace
records.summary: The World Bank reports that Côte d'Ivoire's e-Agriculture project benefited more than 400,000 people in selected agricultural value chains through improved market access and information.

records.title: Benin Digital Rural Transformation agricultural machinery platform
records.summary: Benin's digital rural transformation work includes platforms for agricultural machinery management, crop advisory services and farm monitoring using geospatial data.

records.title: Cameroon agricultural e-voucher system
records.summary: Cameroon's digital transformation project enrolled producers into an electronic voucher system supporting fertilizer and seed subsidies.

records.title: Senegal agricultural warehouse receipt and market infrastructure
records.summary: Senegal strengthened its Warehouse Receipt System and approved 100 warehouses, alongside measures improving agricultural market access and climate-risk management.

records.title: The Gambia agricultural matching-grant programme
records.summary: The Gambia's matching-grant programme has supported agribusinesses, farmers' organizations and SMEs while mobilizing private investment and creating jobs.

records.title: Benin to present agrifood investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Forum
records.summary: FAO announced that Benin is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.summary: FAO announced that Mozambique is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.summary: FAO announced that Zambia is among the African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment opportunities at the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome.

records.headline: Zambia positions four agrifood value chains for 2026 Hand-in-Hand investment
records.summary: FAO reports Zambia refined bankable investment priorities across beef, common beans, soybeans and honey ahead of the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum.

records.headline: Government and FAO launch initiative to catalyse transformative and sustainable food systems in Zambia
records.summary: Zambia and FAO launched a new initiative in September 2026 focused on transforming food systems and strengthening sustainable agrifood development.

records.headline: Kapenta Day 2026 strengthens partnerships and market opportunities in Zambia's kapenta value chain
records.summary: FAO reports that fishers, processors, traders, cooperatives, finance institutions and other stakeholders met in Mpulungu to strengthen market opportunities for the kapenta value chain.

records.headline: Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum convenes in Kigali
records.summary: FAO's Eastern Africa forum in Kigali brought governments, investors, financial institutions, agribusinesses and partners together to showcase investment-ready agrifood opportunities and strengthen regional cooperation.

records.headline: Kapenta Day 2026 strengthens partnerships and market opportunities in Zambia's kapenta value chain
records.summary: More than 100 fishers, processors, traders, cooperatives, financial institutions and other stakeholders gathered in Mpulungu to strengthen partnerships, market access, sustainable fisheries and value addition.

records.headline: Government and FAO launch new initiative to catalyse transformative and sustainable food systems in Zambia
records.summary: A new two-year initiative focuses on food security, nutrition, resilience, sustainable livelihoods, climate-smart agriculture, food safety, market development and livestock traceability.

records.headline: Zambia expands practical agricultural learning through Farmer Field Schools
records.summary: FAO and government partners established Farmer Field School activities for vulnerable farming households across six districts, with a minimum of 90 schools planned and capacity for up to 2,700 farmers.

records.headline: Zambia advances agricultural governance, plant health regulations and digital information systems
records.summary: FAO-supported technical workshops advanced plant health regulations and assessment of the Zambia Integrated Agricultural Management Information System, with emphasis on reliable agricultural data and digital decision-making.

records.headline: FAO launches second call for Zambia SIFAZ Matching Grant Facility
records.summary: The SIFAZ Matching Grant Facility supports eligible Zambian farmers, cooperatives and agribusinesses in mechanization, input acquisition and marketing, commodity aggregation and green enterprises; the 2026 call offered grants from €400 to €60,000.

records.headline: Zambia strengthens agricultural weather knowledge through extension officer training
records.summary: FAO-supported training in Southern Zambia is helping extension officers turn weather and climate information into practical guidance for farmers.

records.headline: FAO highlights Angola's role in Southern Africa irrigation and agrifood investment initiative
records.summary: Angola is included in FAO's 2026 Southern Africa regional investment initiative, with community reservoirs and renewable-energy irrigation among the targeted interventions.

records.headline: FAO highlights Mozambique in Southern Africa irrigation and rice investment plans
records.summary: Mozambique is identified in FAO's 2026 regional initiative for irrigation infrastructure, rice production and agroprocessing opportunities.

records.headline: FAO highlights Malawi in Southern Africa irrigation and rice investment plans
records.summary: Malawi is identified in FAO's 2026 regional initiative for community reservoirs, irrigation and rice value-chain development.

records.headline: Zambia included in FAO regional mechanization investment initiative
records.summary: FAO's Southern Africa 2026 initiative includes Zambia among countries targeted for mechanization hire-service hubs and improved machinery access.

records.headline: Zimbabwe included in FAO regional mechanization and agroprocessing investment initiative
records.summary: FAO's Southern Africa 2026 initiative identifies Zimbabwe for mechanization services, wheat production and soybean agroprocessing opportunities.

records.title: FAO turns Ghana soil data into practical farm-management action
records.summary: FAO and the CSIR–Soil Research Institute are helping farmers in Ghana's Upper West Region translate soil assessments into practical sustainable soil-management decisions under RECSOIL.

records.title: FAO trains extension agents for climate-smart soybean farms in northern Ghana
records.summary: Fifty agricultural extension agents were trained to establish 100 demonstration farms and support about 10,000 smallholder soybean farmers across six districts.

records.title: FAO and EU support Feed Ghana programme with 150,000 poultry birds
records.summary: FAO and the European Union provided poultry birds, feed and training to farmers in northern Ghana as part of efforts to raise local production and reduce import dependence.

records.title: FAO and Ghana strengthen sustainable Fall Armyworm management
records.summary: FAO support is strengthening integrated pest management, farmer training, demonstration trials and biological-control capacity for Fall Armyworm in Ghana.
